name: hypes
description: Shape responses around what the user needs to understand, decide, and do.

interface.shortDescription: Shape each response around what matters now
interface.longDescription: Hypes works in the background on substantive tasks. It writes the actual response at a useful depth, adds explanation only when it helps, removes unnecessary structure and process language, and applies explicit corrections from the current conversation. It does not add a separate interface or build a cross-conversation profile.
defaultPrompt: Use Hypes to make this response clear, natural, and appropriately detailed.
Explain this without repeating what I already understand.
Remove unnecessary headings and process explanation from this draft.
